contrary_evidence: An economy can achieve productivity and consumer welfare gains while importing advanced intermediate goods; import dependence is not automatically evidence of industrial failure.
A higher concentration ratio need not imply acute fragility when stocks, competitive qualified substitutes or alternative process capacity are demonstrably available.
WTO merchandise trade projections suggest aggregate resilience even though EIA estimated severe changes in specific 2026 energy corridors.
limitations: This is a structural multiregional report, not transaction-level tracking or a claim to enumerate all trade flows and routes.

The most recent cited official source vintages differ: 2024 maritime ton-miles and food trade, 2025 port cargo, 2026 Q2 energy chokepoints, and 2022 TiVA value-added estimates. They are never combined into a fictitious common-year ledger.
EIA chokepoint estimates rely partly on shipping tracking, not customs declarations; charted oil flows are quarterly averages, not full-year consumption.
Quantitative diagrams present sources and measurement limits; the regional map is analytical and does not imply vessel GPS tracks or precise coordinates.

producer_checks.editorial_novelty: Inaugural article of the Global Production, Trade and Logistics Geography editorial research agenda. Examines five heterogeneous physical chains and different national/territorial functions; complements rather than duplicates existing energy and geopolitical reports.
producer_checks.research_depth: 18 substantive analytical sections per locale (over 5,700 words each), covering extraction, processing, manufacture, inland and ocean transport, insurance, value added, labour, regional development, economic transmission and 2026 disruptions.
producer_checks.source_check: 16 full original source URLs in both locales, including UNCTAD, WTO, EIA, IEA, FAO, OECD, USGS, World Bank, UN Comtrade, Brazil MDIC, ANTAQ, and port authorities. Published summaries and statistical definitions checked on 9 November 2026.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Two matched bar charts per language: UNCTAD 2024 volume 2.2% and tonne-miles 5.9%; IEA key energy mineral refiners top-three average 82% (2020) and 86% (2024). Three source-qualified tables, two-chain causal flow and five-region analytical map in both locales.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: 18 same analytical sections, identical 16 numbered references, matched five supply-chain case studies, same quantitative series in two charts and the same five comparative region entries. Dates, units and confidence qualifications are matched.
producer_checks.methodology: Distinguishes tonnes, tonne-miles, TEUs, trade value, value-added, original location and port transshipment; cross-sectional averages versus single mineral; source observations versus WTO forecast; stock, flow, ownership and effective physical capacity.
